#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build the calc release binary at ./app.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
mkdir -p build
for src in src/*.s; do
    clang -c -O2 "$src" -o "build/$(basename "${src%.s}").o"
done
clang -O2 build/*.o -o app

// eval.s — evaluate one calc expression line (64-bit signed integers).
//
// Operator-precedence parser driven by an explicit value stack and an
// operator stack, so arbitrarily deep nesting ("((((...", "----...") cannot
// overflow the machine stack. Grammar and semantics: see SPEC.md.
//
// Operator codes carry their precedence in the high nibble:
//   0x00 '('   0x10 '+'  0x11 '-'   0x20 '*'  0x21 '/'  0x22 '%'   0x30 unary '-'

        .equ OP_LPAREN, 0x00
        .equ OP_ADD,    0x10
        .equ OP_SUB,    0x11
        .equ OP_MUL,    0x20
        .equ OP_DIV,    0x21
        .equ OP_MOD,    0x22
        .equ OP_NEG,    0x30

        .equ ST_OK,     0
        .equ ST_ERROR,  1
        .equ ST_BLANK,  2

        .text

// int eval_line(const char *p, const char *end, int64_t *vals, uint8_t *ops)
//   vals / ops must each hold at least (end - p) entries.
//   Returns w0 = ST_OK (value in x1), ST_ERROR, or ST_BLANK (only spaces/tabs).
//
// Register map:
//   x0  cursor            x1  end              x2  vals base   x3  ops base
//   x4  vals top (next)   x5  ops top (next)   w6  state: 0 = expect operand,
//                                                         1 = expect operator
//   w7  current char      x10 INT64_MAX / 10   x14 &binop_tab
//   w11 pending op        w12 pending precedence  w13 op to apply  x8, x9, x15 scratch
        .globl _eval_line
        .p2align 2
_eval_line:
        .cfi_startproc
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
        mov     x29, sp
        .cfi_def_cfa w29, 16
        .cfi_offset w30, -8
        .cfi_offset w29, -16

        mov     x4, x2
        mov     x5, x3
        mov     w6, #0
        mov     x10, #0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC
        lsr     x10, x10, #4                    // 922337203685477580
        adrp    x14, Lbinop_tab@PAGE
        add     x14, x14, Lbinop_tab@PAGEOFF

Lnext:
        cmp     x0, x1
        b.hs    Lend
        ldrb    w7, [x0], #1
        cmp     w7, #' '
        b.eq    Lnext
        cmp     w7, #'\t'
        b.eq    Lnext
        cbnz    w6, Loperator

        // ---- expecting an operand: NUMBER, unary '-', or '(' ----
        sub     w8, w7, #'0'
        cmp     w8, #9
        b.ls    Lnumber
        cmp     w7, #'-'
        b.eq    Lpush_neg
        cmp     w7, #'('
        b.ne    Lerror
        mov     w8, #OP_LPAREN
        strb    w8, [x5], #1
        b       Lnext
Lpush_neg:
        mov     w8, #OP_NEG
        strb    w8, [x5], #1
        b       Lnext

Lnumber:
        mov     x9, x8                          // accumulator
Ldigit:
        cmp     x0, x1
        b.hs    Lnumber_done
        ldrb    w7, [x0]
        sub     w8, w7, #'0'
        cmp     w8, #9
        b.hi    Lnumber_done
        add     x0, x0, #1
        cmp     x9, x10
        b.hi    Lerror                          // acc * 10 would exceed INT64_MAX
        add     x9, x9, x9, lsl #2
        add     x9, x8, x9, lsl #1              // acc = acc * 10 + digit
        tbnz    x9, #63, Lerror                 // > INT64_MAX
        b       Ldigit
Lnumber_done:
        str     x9, [x4], #8
        mov     w6, #1
        b       Lnext

        // ---- expecting an operator: binary op or ')' ----
Loperator:
        cmp     w7, #')'
        b.eq    Lclose
        sub     w8, w7, #'%'
        cmp     w8, #('/' - '%')
        b.hi    Lerror
        ldrb    w11, [x14, w8, uxtw]
        cbz     w11, Lerror
        lsr     w12, w11, #4                    // precedence of the new op
Lreduce:                                        // left-assoc: pop while prec(top) >= prec(new)
        cmp     x5, x3
        b.eq    Lpush_op
        ldrb    w13, [x5, #-1]
        cmp     w12, w13, lsr #4
        b.hi    Lpush_op
        sub     x5, x5, #1
        bl      Lapply
        b       Lreduce
Lpush_op:
        strb    w11, [x5], #1
        mov     w6, #0
        b       Lnext

Lclose:
        cmp     x5, x3
        b.eq    Lerror                          // no matching '('
        ldrb    w13, [x5, #-1]!
        cbz     w13, Lnext                      // matched '(' (still expecting an operator)
        bl      Lapply
        b       Lclose

        // ---- end of line ----
Lend:
        cbnz    w6, Lfinish
        cmp     x4, x2                          // nothing parsed at all => blank line
        ccmp    x5, x3, #0, eq
        b.ne    Lerror                          // dangling operator / '('
        mov     w0, #ST_BLANK
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #16
        ret
Lfinish:
        cmp     x5, x3
        b.eq    Lresult
        ldrb    w13, [x5, #-1]!
        cbz     w13, Lerror                     // unclosed '('
        bl      Lapply
        b       Lfinish
Lresult:
        ldr     x1, [x2]
        mov     w0, #ST_OK
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #16
        ret

Lerror:
        mov     w0, #ST_ERROR
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #16
        ret

// Lapply: local subroutine. Applies operator w13 to the top of the value
// stack (x4). Clobbers x8, x9, x15, flags. Never touches sp, so on overflow or
// division by zero it branches straight to Lerror, which unwinds the frame.
Lapply:
        cmp     w13, #OP_NEG
        b.ne    Lbinary
        ldr     x8, [x4, #-8]
        negs    x8, x8
        b.vs    Lerror                          // -INT64_MIN
        str     x8, [x4, #-8]
        ret
Lbinary:
        ldp     x8, x9, [x4, #-16]!             // x8 = lhs, x9 = rhs
        cmp     w13, #OP_ADD
        b.eq    Ladd
        cmp     w13, #OP_SUB
        b.eq    Lsub
        cmp     w13, #OP_MUL
        b.eq    Lmul
        cbz     x9, Lerror                      // '/' or '%' by zero
        cmp     w13, #OP_DIV
        b.eq    Ldiv
        sdiv    x15, x8, x9                     // '%': INT64_MIN % -1 wraps to 0
        msub    x8, x15, x9, x8
        b       Lstore
Ldiv:
        cmn     x9, #1
        b.ne    1f
        negs    x8, x8                          // x / -1 == -x; overflows for INT64_MIN
        b.vs    Lerror
        b       Lstore
1:      sdiv    x8, x8, x9
        b       Lstore
Ladd:
        adds    x8, x8, x9
        b.vs    Lerror
        b       Lstore
Lsub:
        subs    x8, x8, x9
        b.vs    Lerror
        b       Lstore
Lmul:
        mul     x15, x8, x9
        smulh   x8, x8, x9
        cmp     x8, x15, asr #63                // high half must be sign of low half
        b.ne    Lerror
        mov     x8, x15
Lstore:
        str     x8, [x4], #8
        ret
        .cfi_endproc

        .section __TEXT,__const
// Binary operator codes indexed by (char - '%'); 0 = not an operator.
Lbinop_tab:
        .byte   OP_MOD                          // '%'
        .byte   0, 0, 0, 0                      // '&' '\'' '(' ')'
        .byte   OP_MUL                          // '*'
        .byte   OP_ADD                          // '+'
        .byte   0                               // ','
        .byte   OP_SUB                          // '-'
        .byte   0                               // '.'
        .byte   OP_DIV                          // '/'

.subsections_via_symbols

// format.s — signed 64-bit integer to decimal text.

        .text

// size_t fmt_i64(char *dst, int64_t v)
//   Writes the decimal form of v (no terminator) to dst; returns its length
//   (at most 20 bytes). Leaf; uses a 32-byte scratch area on the stack.
        .globl _fmt_i64
        .p2align 2
_fmt_i64:
        .cfi_startproc
        sub     sp, sp, #32
        .cfi_def_cfa_offset 32
        mov     x2, x0                          // write cursor
        cmp     x1, #0
        cneg    x3, x1, mi                      // |v| as unsigned (INT64_MIN stays 2^63)
        b.pl    1f
        mov     w4, #'-'
        strb    w4, [x2], #1
1:      add     x5, sp, #32                     // digits are produced backwards
        mov     x6, x5
        mov     x7, #10
2:      udiv    x8, x3, x7
        msub    x9, x8, x7, x3
        add     w9, w9, #'0'
        strb    w9, [x6, #-1]!
        mov     x3, x8
        cbnz    x3, 2b
3:      ldrb    w9, [x6], #1
        strb    w9, [x2], #1
        cmp     x6, x5
        b.lo    3b
        sub     x0, x2, x0
        add     sp, sp, #32
        ret
        .cfi_endproc

.subsections_via_symbols

// main.s — calc driver: read stdin, evaluate each line, print results.

        .equ STDIN,       0
        .equ STDOUT,      1
        .equ EINTR,       4
        .equ READ_CHUNK0, 0x100000              // initial input buffer (1 MiB)
        .equ OUT_CAP,     0x10000               // output buffer size
        .equ OUT_SLACK,   32                    // >= longest single result line

        .text

// int main(void)
//   x19 input buffer   x20 input length / end   x21 line cursor
//   x22 input capacity, then eval stack block  x23 eval stack capacity (entries)
//   x24 end of current line   x25 output buffer   x26 output length
        .globl _main
        .p2align 2
_main:
        .cfi_startproc
        sub     sp, sp, #80
        stp     x26, x25, [sp, #0]
        stp     x24, x23, [sp, #16]
        stp     x22, x21, [sp, #32]
        stp     x20, x19, [sp, #48]
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #64]
        add     x29, sp, #64
        .cfi_def_cfa w29, 16
        .cfi_offset w30, -8
        .cfi_offset w29, -16
        .cfi_offset w19, -24
        .cfi_offset w20, -32
        .cfi_offset w21, -40
        .cfi_offset w22, -48
        .cfi_offset w23, -56
        .cfi_offset w24, -64
        .cfi_offset w25, -72
        .cfi_offset w26, -80

        // ---- slurp all of stdin ----
        mov     x22, #READ_CHUNK0
        mov     x0, x22
        bl      _malloc
        cbz     x0, Lfail
        mov     x19, x0
        mov     x20, #0
Lread:
        subs    x2, x22, x20
        b.ne    1f
        lsl     x22, x22, #1                    // full: double the buffer
        mov     x0, x19
        mov     x1, x22
        bl      _realloc
        cbz     x0, Lfail
        mov     x19, x0
        sub     x2, x22, x20
1:      mov     w0, #STDIN
        add     x1, x19, x20
        bl      _read
        cmp     x0, #0
        b.gt    2f
        b.eq    Lread_done
        bl      ___error
        ldr     w8, [x0]
        cmp     w8, #EINTR
        b.eq    Lread
        b       Lread_done                      // treat other read errors as EOF
2:      add     x20, x20, x0
        b       Lread
Lread_done:
        add     x20, x19, x20                   // x20 = end of input
        mov     x21, x19
        mov     x22, #0                         // eval stack block (none yet)
        mov     x23, #0
        adrp    x25, _g_outbuf@PAGE
        add     x25, x25, _g_outbuf@PAGEOFF
        mov     x26, #0

        // ---- one expression per line ----
Lline:
        cmp     x21, x20
        b.hs    Ldone
        mov     x0, x21
        mov     w1, #'\n'
        sub     x2, x20, x21
        bl      _memchr
        cmp     x0, #0
        csel    x24, x20, x0, eq                // last line may lack '\n'

        sub     x8, x24, x21                    // stacks need one slot per byte
        cmp     x8, x23
        b.ls    Lhave_stack
        lsl     x9, x23, #1
        cmp     x8, x9
        csel    x23, x8, x9, hi                 // cap = max(len, 2 * cap)
        mov     x0, x22
        bl      _free
        add     x0, x23, x23, lsl #3            // cap * (8 value bytes + 1 op byte)
        bl      _malloc
        cbz     x0, Lfail
        mov     x22, x0
Lhave_stack:
        mov     x9, #(OUT_CAP - OUT_SLACK)
        cmp     x26, x9
        b.ls    1f
        mov     x0, x25
        mov     x1, x26
        bl      _flush_out
        mov     x26, #0
1:      mov     x0, x21
        mov     x1, x24
        mov     x2, x22
        add     x3, x22, x23, lsl #3
        bl      _eval_line
        cbz     w0, Lprint_value
        cmp     w0, #1
        b.ne    Lnext_line                      // blank line: no output
        adrp    x8, Lerror_text@PAGE
        ldr     x8, [x8, Lerror_text@PAGEOFF]
        str     x8, [x25, x26]                  // 8-byte store, 6 bytes kept
        add     x26, x26, #6
        b       Lnext_line
Lprint_value:
        add     x0, x25, x26
        bl      _fmt_i64
        add     x26, x26, x0
        mov     w8, #'\n'
        strb    w8, [x25, x26]
        add     x26, x26, #1
Lnext_line:
        add     x21, x24, #1
        b       Lline

Ldone:
        mov     x0, x25
        mov     x1, x26
        bl      _flush_out
        mov     x0, x22
        bl      _free
        mov     x0, x19
        bl      _free
        mov     w0, #0
        b       Lreturn
Lfail:
        mov     w0, #1
Lreturn:
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp, #64]
        ldp     x20, x19, [sp, #48]
        ldp     x22, x21, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x24, x23, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x26, x25, [sp, #0]
        add     sp, sp, #80
        ret
        .cfi_endproc

// void flush_out(const char *buf, size_t len)
//   Writes the whole buffer to stdout, retrying short writes and EINTR.
        .p2align 2
_flush_out:
        .cfi_startproc
        stp     x20, x19, [sp, #-32]!
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #16]
        add     x29, sp, #16
        .cfi_def_cfa w29, 16
        .cfi_offset w30, -8
        .cfi_offset w29, -16
        .cfi_offset w19, -24
        .cfi_offset w20, -32
        mov     x19, x0
        mov     x20, x1
1:      cbz     x20, 3f
        mov     w0, #STDOUT
        mov     x1, x19
        mov     x2, x20
        bl      _write
        cmp     x0, #0
        b.lt    2f
        add     x19, x19, x0
        sub     x20, x20, x0
        b       1b
2:      bl      ___error
        ldr     w8, [x0]
        cmp     w8, #EINTR
        b.eq    1b
3:      ldp     x29, x30, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x20, x19, [sp], #32
        ret
        .cfi_endproc

        .section __TEXT,__const
        .p2align 3
Lerror_text:
        .ascii  "error\n\0\0"

        .zerofill __DATA,__bss,_g_outbuf,OUT_CAP,4

.subsections_via_symbols
